diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate downward trend (a net fall of ~85% of its level). A moderate seasonal pattern is present. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (1 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.17), which favours a robust combination.
